programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻：環球新聞檔案粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 百年黃金路‧香港再啟航粵
茶煲世家#56粵
programme.desc: (大結局)家宜誤會子東罔顧腹中骨肉，堅決與他離婚，子東遂帶同驗孕報告向家宜澄清，二人終和好。Roger告知子東公司將分配一宿舍單位給他，二人將是鄰居，並且考慮由達松和明輝爭取接任子東原來職位。達松遂施計偷走明輝之計劃書，幸明輝發覺及時取回文件，成功升職。劍棠與家玲正為找尋新居頭痛，子東提議把現居賣給家玲，家玲即以當年原價買入，子東啞口無言。幾日後，家玲到地產公司咨詢，並主動提高售樓價，子東即答應。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#8粵普PG
programme.desc: 十一娘和徐令宜為蜀錦一事再次鬧得不歡而散。蓮房故意在徐令宜面前穿蜀錦欲討他歡心，卻被徐令宜以冷言冷語對待，深深不憤，因而設計擄走十一娘，以圖破壞其名聲，琥珀回羅府告知太夫人此事，太夫人深感事有蹺蹊。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 中國茶不但是飯後消滯去膩的佳品，原來亦可入饌，為菜式添上絲絲茶香美味。鼎爺今回先用龍井茶葉搭配鳳尾蝦，帶來清香的「龍井蝦仁」；及後再以普洱茶葉煮雞，奉上煙燻味香濃的「茶燻雞」。除了分享昔日和「老頭子」自製魚桿釣河蝦的美好回憶，鼎爺還會介紹保存茶葉的傳統方法。人參大有補身、補氣的功效，焗水、煲湯皆宜。鼎爺外出細說揀選優質高麗參及吉林紅參的「小貼士」之後，返回「煮場」獻技，呈獻滋補佳餚「高麗參浸雞」。

programme.title: 百年黃金路‧香港再啟航粵
流行都市粵
programme.desc: 肥胖症患者出於胰島素阻抗、慢性發炎等原因，較易同時患上肌少症，這情況在長者間相當普遍。病人有何常見症狀？容易引發甚麼嚴重併發症？測試手握力與計算肌肉指數，則可初步斷症。內分泌及糖尿科醫生亦細說以「慢減重加保肌」為目標的治療方案。人面對突如其來事故，情緒或受影響，精神科醫生提出幾個疏導負面情緒的建議，並傳授一些控制情緒的方法。飲碗熱湯有助禦寒，傅季馨在「睇餸食飯」環節教大家製作「煎帶子伴栗子蓉湯」。

programme.title: 長命不老粵
programme.desc: 鄧佩儀、許文軒往肇慶鼎湖尋找補腦秘技，答案竟是大媽廣場舞？馮盈盈、江嘉敏即席自創舞步，腦科醫生解說跳舞有助增強記憶力，並進行腦力測試及訓練左右腦協調方法。探訪鼎湖91歲老伯，拆解長壽村鮮為人知的不老秘密！何謂「加齡臭」？中醫建議進食清熱潤燥食品，還教沖飲緩和體味的竹葉菊花茶。營養師推介泰式健腦三文魚藜麥沙律，有益腦部健康及延緩記憶衰退，並講解麥得飲食(MIND Diet)，一隻雞蛋能有助集中精神？

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#18粵PG
programme.desc: 兆良持警槍偷渡往澳門，被勒令停職接受調查。家聰主動找曦昕關心狀況，加以開解。阿昌終認得天龍之情婦柔紫，駿昇認定柔紫接近月華有企圖，到醫院要求冠一及正花帶他到港搜尋。駿昇在冠一家不見月華蹤影，緊張地要冠一找出柔紫所在，卻不成功。月華與駿昇分別向柔紫、冠一解釋當日事情及過往兄弟相處之事宜。冠一終找到被擊暈的柔紫，月華卻下落不明。月華醒來，驚見天龍在眼前……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 情人節將至，姐姐打算自製巧克力送給秀樹，但看見小渚為花輪特別炮製的巧克力後，決定投放更多心思重新製作。小杉因身型肥大，玩擠饅頭遊戲特別受歡迎，豬太郎感到羨慕，於是想盡辦法增肥自己。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 又到做運動時間，依兒童體適能教練指示做幾下熱身跳，就正式開展「WORKOUT 2GETHER」。先是「全身力量訓練」，深蹲、平板支撐、超人式等熱門動作，如何做得好？收緊肚皮就是核心訓練的要點。弓步跳起時前後腳交替的動作，則可促進血液循環。輪到「下肢協調訓練」，同樣需要收緊肚皮，箭步蹲、側弓步、單腳原地跳、雙腳爆發跳，都有助改善平衡力，減少跌倒機會。動作做到熟練時，還可嘗試增加頻率，加強訓練效率。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: Ruby=Lazuli與AISMIRIN’兩大人氣組合攜手宣佈，偶像公主大賽即將舉行。學生會會長一條寺櫻與副會長二階堂珠希的Ruby=Lazuli也決定出戰第一場大賽。然而，珠希卻發現，櫻的真正目的並非大賽本身……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 香港經歷過多次的移民潮，八十年代有不少香港人選擇移居加拿大，引發「太空人」這社會現象的出現，即是那些已經移民他鄉，但是還未完全放棄香港的事業，需要兩地往返的人，新聞掏寶和大家重溫1989年的專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵 及 百年黃金路‧香港再啟航粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 滙豐Premier Elite 呈獻：滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 私人屋苑住戶求助，稱樓上居民經常將煙頭丟出窗外，並落到其單位平台，擔心引致意外。管理公司縱加裝閉路電視，惟情況仍未有改善。已婚女士於巴士站遇男子搭訕，繼而發展出不倫戀。期間，男方多次向女事主借錢共逾六十萬，甚至聲稱鄉下土地即將發展高鐵，收到賠償就會還款。女事主為幫情郎，不惜向親友借貸，最終債台高築。男方一直未有還款，態度更漸趨惡劣，女事主於是「報東張」……另外，這集帶來有助改善關節退化的相關資訊。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2705粵
programme.desc: 天娥發現璟風為瑞素大灑金錢，認為瑞素存心「討着數」，遂警告她不可再亂花錢。瑞素決定與璟風採用「AA制」，各自支付自己應付的費用，結果讓璟風吃了不少苦頭。另一方面，瑞素即將出埠公幹，為「慳錢」而拒絕入住璟風為她安排的高級酒店。璟風想到一個可讓瑞素自願入住該酒店的方法，詎料……其後，瑞素如期前赴外地，酒店附近竟發生危險事故，璟風大感憂心，務要設法確保瑞素的安全……

programme.title: Return 關節筋肌配方呈獻 :守誠者#3粵PG
programme.desc: 林蔚言發現戈登涉嫌殺人的新聞，同時，戈登聯繫林蔚言，並以“一個足以摧毀香港的陰謀”取得了林蔚言信任，答應與他見面。何浩輝收到陳耀揚的資訊，獨自趕往李大年處，卻發現跟蹤自己的邵子俊。

programme.title: 去有風的地方#22粵普
programme.desc: 之遙得知紅豆被欺負，向其道歉，紅豆則因之遙遇事不說而生氣，之遙再寫信道歉。紅豆準備回北京處理房子水管爆裂一事時，之遙接到謝老師心臟病發的電話，紅豆陪其去醫院。謝老師病情逐漸好轉，之遙放心陪紅豆去北京。

programme.title: 大航假期呈獻:玩轉桂林懶人包粵
programme.desc: 投入陽朔的民族色彩與絕美風光，三位主持換上壯族傳統服飾，遊走富里古橋，在水中滿月倒影相伴下盡情打卡。灕江楊堤段結合奇峰、綠林、江水美景，兩男坐竹筏沉醉詩畫般的景致，有人「醉到」撞頭？置身九馬畫山下，體驗江邊片石樂趣。一嚐螺螄粉的獨特味道，下榻以山水奇觀襯托的度假村，再騎馬暢遊九里花海，吃喝玩樂頂級享受！遊陽朔必吃「金桔宴」，每道創意精緻料理都與金桔清香完美融和。家燕姐還往咖啡店放空，悠閒自在一番。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻：環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵

名媛望族#4粵
programme.desc: 卓萬向廷亨暗示已知他勾當，要爭做商會主席，結果廷亨當選，啟燊終明卓萬用心。卓萬贈子君象棋，內藏頸鏈；懿芳代卓萬答應出席上海飯店剪綵，爾嫣竟考慮同行。心蘭與懿芳受傷，啟燁替卓萬找理由，讓他與爾嫣到上海。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 肥胖症患者出於胰島素阻抗、慢性發炎等原因，較易同時患上肌少症，這情況在長者間相當普遍。病人有何常見症狀？容易引發甚麼嚴重併發症？測試手握力與計算肌肉指數，則可初步斷症。內分泌及糖尿科醫生亦細說以「慢減重加保肌」為目標的治療方案。人面對突如其來事故，情緒或受影響，精神科醫生提出幾個疏導負面情緒的建議，並傳授一些控制情緒的方法。飲碗熱湯有助禦寒，傅季馨在「睇餸食飯」環節教大家製作「煎帶子伴栗子蓉湯」。

programme.title: 茶煲世家#56粵
programme.desc: (大結局)家宜誤會子東罔顧腹中骨肉，堅決與他離婚，子東遂帶同驗孕報告向家宜澄清，二人終和好。Roger告知子東公司將分配一宿舍單位給他，二人將是鄰居，並且考慮由達松和明輝爭取接任子東原來職位。達松遂施計偷走明輝之計劃書，幸明輝發覺及時取回文件，成功升職。劍棠與家玲正為找尋新居頭痛，子東提議把現居賣給家玲，家玲即以當年原價買入，子東啞口無言。幾日後，家玲到地產公司咨詢，並主動提高售樓價，子東即答應。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#8粵普PG
programme.desc: 十一娘和徐令宜為蜀錦一事再次鬧得不歡而散。蓮房故意在徐令宜面前穿蜀錦欲討他歡心，卻被徐令宜以冷言冷語對待，深深不憤，因而設計擄走十一娘，以圖破壞其名聲，琥珀回羅府告知太夫人此事，太夫人深感事有蹺蹊。

programme.title: 乜都搞掂晒粵
programme.desc: 曾志偉請各人吃辣壽司，笑指有「吃wasabi不攻鼻」的秘方，並從化學角度解釋。張致恒親自示範2分鐘出門之法，並詳述如何極速綁鞋帶及打領呔。倒數飲管循環再用法的五強，飲管竟可通渠、變成迷你收納小管？

programme.title: 乜都搞掂晒粵
programme.desc: 陳展鵬指用粉筆為食物圍圈可防蟻蛀，這說法有否科學根據？有甚麼方法可以極速切橙，或極速倒出布丁？妙用蘋果皮及沸水，製造天然的鍋漬清潔劑。膠樽放入洗衣機竟有助除污？一同學習設立膠樽裝置活捉討厭蚊子！

高朋滿座#1粵
programme.desc: 有朋生日，家人毫無表示，原來家人預備了驚喜，由不懂下廚的悅滿焗蛋糕，結果異常醜陋。有朋感激，謂「這是最漂亮的蛋糕」。家人浪費了有朋的愛心飯盒，有朋大發脾氣不肯入廚，眾人再買一個蛋糕，成功哄回有朋入廚。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#9粵普PG
programme.desc: 十一娘及時逃脫回到羅家，總算化解危機，並向徐令宜暗示此事跟蓮房有關，徐令宜告訴蓮房已將劉媽媽調走。諄哥病情反覆，十一娘用心照顧他，卻被羅大太太質疑她一直對諄哥不聞不問，提醒她要記住自己羅家人的身分。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 為了答謝鼎爺煮出各式各樣的美食佳餚，阿譚帶他飽餐美味雲吞麵作回報。返回「阿爺廚房」，鼎爺用玫瑰露、高粱酒及滷水料把乳鴿先煮後冷藏，奉上酒香撲鼻的「醉鴿」；及後再示範家常小菜「蝦膏通菜」，當中有何烹調要點？糉慣常不外乎蒸、烚兩種做法，鼎爺卻精心推介「油炸糉」，重現懷舊風味；他還講解蘆兜糉、鹹肉糉、梘水糉的分別。吃過油炸食物後，擔心會熱氣上火？鼎爺隨即帶來清甜可口的「黑白耳糖水」，讓大家滋潤一番！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 冬至是一年之中，日照最短的一天，中醫學認為此時陰氣最盛、陽氣初生，適當進補能為健康打好基礎。中醫師提醒於冷天要多加注意，如避免赤腳接觸地面、保持早睡晚起，都有助冬日養生。醫師還淺談冬季飲食建議，並帶來合適食療與穴位。前旋足是一種步姿，但若出現過度前旋足，或會引致足底筋膜炎、拇趾外翻等狀況。物理治療師詳析相關成因與治療，並示範防治運動。「睇餸食飯」，Annie師傅奉上「客家鹹湯丸」，以暖意迎接冬至。

programme.title: 長命不老粵
programme.desc: 逆齡偵探走訪台北與廣州，體驗拔罐、陽掌拍打療法，為何施行陽掌拍打的醫師要修習氣功？註冊中醫細談足底拔罐對舒緩關節痛症的功效，並帶來可強化筋骨的淮山杜仲湯。脊醫為嘉賓袁文傑就肩膊老化、小腿肌肉柔軟度、大腿肌及臀肌協調作測試，小腿肌肉過緊原來容易引致多方面的後遺症！從鞋底的磨損程度，也可檢視足部與膝蓋健康，誰的步行姿勢最標準？聞說浸白醋水能滋潤主婦手，皮膚科醫生反指會越浸越乾！不如自製燕麥水潤手更佳。

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#19粵PG
programme.desc: 天龍訴說墮海後大難不死，卻失憶，重拾記憶後誓要奪回所有。冠一指當日只想查出天龍死因，卻發現事實與心中所想完全是兩回事，感到不知所措。柏義與美詩幽會，被林磊撞破，柏義在威逼下答應替林磊工作。天龍承認駿昇所說的事實，希望冠一與他一同取回娛樂城。冠一向天龍介紹「七傑」，天龍希望大家支持他重奪娛樂城，「七傑」心中卻不想繼續參與事件。駿昇勉強帶笑出席娛樂集團晚會，天龍竟帶同月華現身……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 前田同學衣服上的紐扣不見了，但遍尋不獲，藤木發現紐扣掉進了自己的手提袋，卻不敢說出來。小丸子擦走家中白板上自己的留言，卻不慎把媽媽的留言擦去部分，唯有循剩下的「大」字作出種種聯想。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 「Artspiration」的新繪畫導師Cherry姐姐，教大家畫雪人預祝聖誕。雪人的身體由三個圓形構成，再畫三個三角形勾勒聖誕樹，簡單構圖已大致完成，為令作品更豐富，導師為雪人加添飾物，會是甚麼？「開心SHARE」我最有趣的裝扮主題，有小孩分享萬聖節特別造型。主持姐姐也公開其特別扮相，「化身」小仙子、超級英雄；觀眾亦可看到鈴鈴姐姐扮演婆婆的照片。「AI小學堂」，嘉賓細談如何利用氛圍編程創作遊戲。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 陽葵摸黑在宿舍做直播被維多利亞校長逮住，校長遂即禁止全校學生進行偶像公主活動。為了讓校長理解友情的美好、解除偶像公主禁令，學生會長阿櫻請求陽葵與美月組成二人組合，登台表演。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 沙田一間三層高村屋，設計師以波希米亞風為概念，利用強烈顏色對比，營造熱情、奔放特點，最終效果如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 百年黃金路‧香港再啟航粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2706粵
programme.desc: 潮偉身分特殊，本來決不可以公開露面，但基於某些理由，得以跟尚善等人短暫團聚。另一方面，特務學校的前校長Mr Q決意要暗殺潮偉，以圖奪回自己失去的一切，並為此作出不少嘗試，卻不果。Mr Q知悉潮偉將要出埠，並前赴一個非常偏遠的地方工作，圖謀趁機對付潮偉，但行動之前必須先找出潮偉的死穴，於是暗中展開查探工作。幾經波折，Mr Q最終發現潮偉的弱點，打算以此對付他，詎料……

programme.title: Return 關節筋肌配方呈獻 :守誠者#4粵PG
programme.desc: 邵子俊偶然見到蔡卓欣，並得知何浩輝有個兒子。何浩輝帶何樂軒去攀岩，阿軒在父親的鼓勵下贏得了獎品，蔡卓欣深感欣慰。與此同時，林蔚言去重慶大廈看望戈登，趁林蔚言不備，戈登偷偷用手機複製了房間的門禁卡資料。

programme.title: 去有風的地方#23粵普
programme.desc: 有魚決定去北京找蔓君，眾人到酒吧見證他最後一晚當駐場歌手；同時紅豆與之遙在馬房見證小馬出生，並再次確認彼此的關係。一年過去，紅豆的民宿正在試業，有魚亦找到真愛，眾人齊集雲苗村祝賀民宿開業，樂也融融。

programme.title: 大航假期呈獻:玩轉桂林懶人包粵
programme.desc: 灕江的每一段風光都呈現獨特風貌，家燕姐豪氣包船與拍檔們遊船河，以「養生」玩法歎靚景，還可近距離與鸕鷀互動。列車高速駛越山嶺，猶如在山水畫中穿梭，三人一探打卡秘境。以灕江山水奇觀作舞台背景的大型演出，同樣震撼眼球！十里畫廊風景線連貫綿綿不絕的群山、田園風光，寫意自駕遊最識玩！「慢活」過後，不妨感受陽朔的熱鬧文化風情，家燕姐帶隊行逛文創小店林立的西街，也會品嚐當地名菜「啤酒魚」，享受宵夜開心時光。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻：環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
名媛望族#5粵
programme.desc: 卓萬拿出多年前送爾嫣被拒收的襟針，爾嫣感動。卓萬請子君陪爾嫣遊覽，日輝遺爾嫣贈他的古錢，被子君拾到。爾嫣發現卓萬安排日輝往倫敦，兩人爭吵。子君見卓萬飲酒，卓萬強吻她。卓萬等回家，眾發現他未與爾嫣同行。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 冬至是一年之中，日照最短的一天，中醫學認為此時陰氣最盛、陽氣初生，適當進補能為健康打好基礎。中醫師提醒於冷天要多加注意，如避免赤腳接觸地面、保持早睡晚起，都有助冬日養生。醫師還淺談冬季飲食建議，並帶來合適食療與穴位。前旋足是一種步姿，但若出現過度前旋足，或會引致足底筋膜炎、拇趾外翻等狀況。物理治療師詳析相關成因與治療，並示範防治運動。「睇餸食飯」，Annie師傅奉上「客家鹹湯丸」，以暖意迎接冬至。

programme.title: 長命不老粵
programme.desc: 逆齡偵探走訪台北與廣州，體驗拔罐、陽掌拍打療法，為何施行陽掌拍打的醫師要修習氣功？註冊中醫細談足底拔罐對舒緩關節痛症的功效，並帶來可強化筋骨的淮山杜仲湯。脊醫為嘉賓袁文傑就肩膊老化、小腿肌肉柔軟度、大腿肌及臀肌協調作測試，小腿肌肉過緊原來容易引致多方面的後遺症！從鞋底的磨損程度，也可檢視足部與膝蓋健康，誰的步行姿勢最標準？聞說浸白醋水能滋潤主婦手，皮膚科醫生反指會越浸越乾！不如自製燕麥水潤手更佳。

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#19粵PG
programme.desc: 天龍訴說墮海後大難不死，卻失憶，重拾記憶後誓要奪回所有。冠一指當日只想查出天龍死因，卻發現事實與心中所想完全是兩回事，感到不知所措。柏義與美詩幽會，被林磊撞破，柏義在威逼下答應替林磊工作。天龍承認駿昇所說的事實，希望冠一與他一同取回娛樂城。冠一向天龍介紹「七傑」，天龍希望大家支持他重奪娛樂城，「七傑」心中卻不想繼續參與事件。駿昇勉強帶笑出席娛樂集團晚會，天龍竟帶同月華現身……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#1粵
programme.desc: 有朋生日，家人毫無表示，原來家人預備了驚喜，由不懂下廚的悅滿焗蛋糕，結果異常醜陋。有朋感激，謂「這是最漂亮的蛋糕」。家人浪費了有朋的愛心飯盒，有朋大發脾氣不肯入廚，眾人再買一個蛋糕，成功哄回有朋入廚。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#9粵普PG
programme.desc: 十一娘及時逃脫回到羅家，總算化解危機，並向徐令宜暗示此事跟蓮房有關，徐令宜告訴蓮房已將劉媽媽調走。諄哥病情反覆，十一娘用心照顧他，卻被羅大太太質疑她一直對諄哥不聞不問，提醒她要記住自己羅家人的身分。

programme.title: 區區添食平安夜粵
programme.desc: 安德尊、張美妮與嘉賓走訪四區，吃盡各國特色聖誕美食！肉眼扒、T骨扒、斧頭扒同時享用，同一條三文魚有六種食法，《夜宵磨》的范振鋒、樂瞳、王梓軒有甚麼食評？謝東閔、陳婉衡、朱智賢走過《天與地》，在港遍尋德國、瑞士、泰國、東南亞美食，不過要小心大王的失儀！火雞配以三種中式食法，會是怎樣的味道？與梁嘉琪、張秀文、湯洛雯享用築地直送刺身、貴族氣質下午茶及欣賞着維港美景把酒當歌，最後竟成功撮合一段好姻緣？

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻：環球新聞檔案粵
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 馬賽克是永恆的藝術 約旦米底巴是一個目光所及之處都有馬賽克的城市, 有各種宗教的文化和諧共存, 使得她有馬賽克之城的美譽 除了藝術價值、歷史價值, 對於米底巴的地區經濟亦起了十分重要的角色

programme.title: 排檔尋情味粵英
programme.desc: 走進新加坡不同世代小販的生活，感受他們之間的關愛、爭吵以及他們對彼此堅定不移的支持。

programme.title: 西葡潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 芷珮住進葡萄牙首都里斯本的遊艇屋，在船頭享受日光浴，好Chill！乘搭山城電梯，欣賞居高臨下的市景。參觀卡爾莫修道院，感受教堂經歷地震洗禮後的獨有淒美。轉赴色彩斑斕的佩納宮，在古蹟宮殿下零死角打卡。芷珮發掘當地的玩偶醫院，即場為囡囡的毛公仔「急救」，順道參觀醫院博物館，了解玩偶修復程序，細看滿載歷史的洋娃娃。潮人必到美食廣場，吃盡葡國美食；不忘品嚐正宗葡撻！坐船遊「小威尼斯」阿威羅小鎮，慢活人生。

programme.title: 玩轉香港日與夜粵
programme.desc: 呼吸清新空氣有助釋放生活壓力，游莨維、黃耀英、吳幸美結伴來到元朗郊外，用兩日一夜享受「有機」週末假期。位於香港西北面的下白泥，擁有廣闊開揚景致，因而成為捕捉日落美景的攝影熱點，三位主持欣賞美景之餘，不忘拍照「呃Like」。野外露營不用勞師動眾，三位主持輕裝上陣，教大家如何「兩手揈揈」去露營，期間更可體驗原野「煮飯仔」樂趣！幾位反斗星齊齊走進士多啤梨莊園，一嚐即摘即食滋味，還拿起魚竿體驗釣蝦樂趣。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 聖誕節是基督教紀念耶穌誕生的節日，因此又名「耶誕節」。將聖誕節定於每年12月25日，傳說與太陽神有關。谷主凱文認為聖誕老人的由來純屬虛構故事，凱婷卻持相反意見。瀅仴則找到據說是聖誕老人的原型資料，還指出其形象的傳播與產品宣傳密不可分。谷主們同時談及聖誕樹由來的流傳故事，為節日增添氣氛與趣味。眾谷主又分享不同的度佳節活動，並推薦心水的聖誕市集。她們亦會淺談現時聖誕節可會過度商業化，各有甚麼看法？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 檸檬掌門人粵英
programme.desc: 柚子、佛手、魚子醬檸檬，檸檬家族規模龐大。在日本南部的高地，柚子的種植使一個村莊免於滅絕。在法國，種植一千多種柑橘類水果，其中大多數鮮為人知。在西西里島，它成為這個國家最精緻的餐桌上的美味。

programme.title: 全城一叮粵
programme.desc: 孟希璘、彭翔翎以趣劇送上娛樂，讓觀眾看得開心。富默契的動作能夠呈現，不可缺少藏身佈景板後的隱藏成員。為展示不一樣的魅力，利穎怡、吳綺珊、李君妍、蕭麗芠在台上傾盡所能，唱跳、耍功夫之餘，還藉小劇場發放正能量。曾因病住院的羅永健，從劇集主題曲<心呼吸獲得力量。他希望憑歌寄意，惟未開聲已有觀眾無情撳叮……林子超開場化身男低音輕展歌藝後，華麗轉身以勁爆造型及舞步震撼全場，就連主持、嘉賓都High爆激讚！

programme.title: 你想減壓粵
programme.desc: 焦慮或源於壓力，有人選擇大吃大喝釋放負能量，營養師卻提醒要「識揀」，食黑朱古力、果仁就可減壓。嘉賓陳豪即場沖製療癒級咖啡，而咖啡可對抗因壓力產生的自由基，但建議每日飲用不宜超過三杯。陳豪透過照片及影片分享一家五口的家庭樂，跟小朋友相處亦是其減壓方法之一。另外，原來粉飾家中牆身、執拾一下擺設，也可增添舒壓效果，但要特別注意時鐘、植物的擺放位置。今集亦訪問花藝師與心理學家，了解顏色與放鬆心情的關係。

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之動物新紀錄粵普
programme.desc: 什麼動物腿最多？什麼動物最愛乾淨？什麼動物最長壽？想知道這些動物界神奇的世界紀錄嗎？快和皮皮龍一起走進奇妙的動物世界吧！探索動物新紀錄，神奇發現全記住！

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之動物新紀錄粵普
programme.desc: 什麼動物腿最多？什麼動物最愛乾淨？什麼動物最長壽？想知道這些動物界神奇的世界紀錄嗎？快和皮皮龍一起走進奇妙的動物世界吧！探索動物新紀錄，神奇發現全記住！

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 做運動要做到微帶喘氣，才是最有效，準備好動起來了嗎？準備好氣球，先跟兒童體適能教練做「全身協調訓練」。將氣球以不同形式輕碰腳跟，再用弓步姿勢做出類似打籃球的帶球動作；還有雙手持球大幅度舉起和碰膝的練習，做到氣喘也屬正常反應！接着要維持坐下或躺下姿勢，藉「划船」、捲腹等動作，集中鍛練核心肌肉，將腳抬起是訓練精粹？如覺得吃力，教練亦會帶來難度降低的版本，但要操到腹肌位置帶點酸痛，才算合格。

programme.title: 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。

programme.title: 科學×冒險 絕境求生手冊粵日
programme.desc: 一個寒冷的夜晚，市民耗電量隨之大增。一座發電廠出現故障，加上種種巧合重疊，導致全市鎮陷入大停電！沈武與兩兄妹被困在商場的升解機，孫女茱爾收到求救，立即與智悟等人前往救援，卻遭逢道路大塞車……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 永澤擔心區內的火堆會造成火災，於是提議組織巡邏隊，查察區內有否可疑火種，小丸子亦被拖下水。天寒地凍，小丸子跟爸爸和爺爺留在家中，隨著電視機故障，兩人談起小時候關於看電影的趣事。

programme.title: 榮寶齋粵
programme.desc: 節目聚焦榮寶齋代代堅守、薪火相傳的百年歷程，透過榮寶齋這一中國文化與藝術發展的重要縮影，展現中國傳統文化的魅力與蓬勃的生命力。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
香港中旅集團呈獻：新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 《新聞透視》，每周專題報道多段香港以至國際的矚目新聞，聚焦港人最關心的民生話題，並邀請各界人士、學者、專家，一同深入探討箇中來龍去脈。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 保濟丸130 週年呈獻:中年好聲音4之百強誕生粵
programme.desc: 香港賽區海選展開，「中3師姐」劉曉昆、陳嘉琦為觀眾追訪並進行記錄。新一季參賽者來自五湖四海，瑞典、日本、菲律賓等地都有好聲音前來追夢。候選者中亦充滿各行業精英，包括心臟科醫生、電影導演、遺體化妝師等，可感受到眾人決心追夢的勇氣。更有初選者透露早前獲聘新工作，其中一個條件竟是需要參加《中年好聲音》？另外，除了曾出道的專業歌手，不少選手亦累積參加歌唱比賽的經驗，預期這季將上演動聽連場的高水準音樂比拼。

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 香港金牛籃球隊舉行誓師大會，公佈征戰NBL新賽季的強力外援，其中有NBA前球員加盟，以衝擊三連霸為目標！WTT香港總決賽圓滿落幕，這集重溫男單、女單、混雙的巔峰戰報。港超聯上演「港島打吡」，南區以1比0擊敗東區。賽前亦舉辦嘉年華，透過不同攤位活動帶動氣氛。國家及地區奧委會協會年會將於明年首次落戶香港，屆時集結逾千名體育界名人同場交流，送上記者會花絮。大灣區五人籃球賽召集中、小學生，藉競技擴闊眼界。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 中信股份呈獻：財經透視粵
programme.desc: 《財經透視》緊貼大市，回顧每周港股走勢外，並關注樓市狀況，透過業界人士專訪、市場分析等，深入淺出探討本港、國際財經金融熱門話題，更以專題形式報道不同行業發展面對的問題。

programme.title: 新鮮人#19粵PG
programme.desc: 麗華知悉家輝替她配了隱形眼鏡，一愕。浩浩見子聰、立春各有好歸宿，感慨下自殺，幸家謙及時阻止並邀請她回家住。徐少嫻丈夫董志遠聘多間私家偵探社找尋少嫻與前夫女兒。某大公司欲招攬家輝，但家輝為家謙等人堅拒。家謙、韋文互相拾到對方錢包，惜始終緣慳一面。浩浩因家輝等不是一家人，故不肯吃團年飯，家輝遂契了立春、浩浩為弟妹。麗華獨自逛花市，喜遇家輝，家輝鼓勵她重讀中五完成心願。一年過後，各人亦有所轉變。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 玩轉香港日與夜粵
programme.desc: 呼吸清新空氣有助釋放生活壓力，游莨維、黃耀英、吳幸美結伴來到元朗郊外，用兩日一夜享受「有機」週末假期。位於香港西北面的下白泥，擁有廣闊開揚景致，因而成為捕捉日落美景的攝影熱點，三位主持欣賞美景之餘，不忘拍照「呃Like」。野外露營不用勞師動眾，三位主持輕裝上陣，教大家如何「兩手揈揈」去露營，期間更可體驗原野「煮飯仔」樂趣！幾位反斗星齊齊走進士多啤梨莊園，一嚐即摘即食滋味，還拿起魚竿體驗釣蝦樂趣。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 聖誕節是基督教紀念耶穌誕生的節日，因此又名「耶誕節」。將聖誕節定於每年12月25日，傳說與太陽神有關。谷主凱文認為聖誕老人的由來純屬虛構故事，凱婷卻持相反意見。瀅仴則找到據說是聖誕老人的原型資料，還指出其形象的傳播與產品宣傳密不可分。谷主們同時談及聖誕樹由來的流傳故事，為節日增添氣氛與趣味。眾谷主又分享不同的度佳節活動，並推薦心水的聖誕市集。她們亦會淺談現時聖誕節可會過度商業化，各有甚麼看法？

programme.title: 全城一叮粵
programme.desc: 孟希璘、彭翔翎以趣劇送上娛樂，讓觀眾看得開心。富默契的動作能夠呈現，不可缺少藏身佈景板後的隱藏成員。為展示不一樣的魅力，利穎怡、吳綺珊、李君妍、蕭麗芠在台上傾盡所能，唱跳、耍功夫之餘，還藉小劇場發放正能量。曾因病住院的羅永健，從劇集主題曲<心呼吸獲得力量。他希望憑歌寄意，惟未開聲已有觀眾無情撳叮……林子超開場化身男低音輕展歌藝後，華麗轉身以勁爆造型及舞步震撼全場，就連主持、嘉賓都High爆激讚！

programme.title: 你想減壓粵
programme.desc: 焦慮或源於壓力，有人選擇大吃大喝釋放負能量，營養師卻提醒要「識揀」，食黑朱古力、果仁就可減壓。嘉賓陳豪即場沖製療癒級咖啡，而咖啡可對抗因壓力產生的自由基，但建議每日飲用不宜超過三杯。陳豪透過照片及影片分享一家五口的家庭樂，跟小朋友相處亦是其減壓方法之一。另外，原來粉飾家中牆身、執拾一下擺設，也可增添舒壓效果，但要特別注意時鐘、植物的擺放位置。今集亦訪問花藝師與心理學家，了解顏色與放鬆心情的關係。

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 馬賽克是永恆的藝術 約旦米底巴是一個目光所及之處都有馬賽克的城市, 有各種宗教的文化和諧共存, 使得她有馬賽克之城的美譽 除了藝術價值、歷史價值, 對於米底巴的地區經濟亦起了十分重要的角色

programme.title: 排檔尋情味粵英
programme.desc: 走進新加坡不同世代小販的生活，感受他們之間的關愛、爭吵以及他們對彼此堅定不移的支持。

programme.desc: 擅長解決問題的小學生彼得，在路上救了一隻狼後，意外展開穿越時空的奇幻冒險！勇者與惡龍、精靈與半人馬、複製人與隱形人……彼得與狼的精采奇遇，就此展開！

programme.title: 我的魯蛇舅舅
programme.desc: 【翻拍BBC人氣英劇／魯蛇舅舅Ｘ強迫症外甥溫馨爆笑的家庭喜劇】由《雖然是精神病但沒關係》的自閉症哥哥吳正世，首次擔任男主角，在選秀節目中獲勝的他，本該朝歌手夢前進，不料積蓄突然遭朋友騙光，從此一蹶不振，成為無業遊名。某天因為姊姊與家暴丈夫離婚，而開始照顧起強迫症的外甥，過程中兩人總是不斷鬥嘴，關係相愛又相殺，而他也從中找回責任感，成為外甥的超人舅舅。

programme.title: 榴蓮小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳時空穿越竟重逢前世伴侶】韓國狗血教母林成漢2023年全新力作！朝鮮時代的杜榴蓮，雖嫁給丈夫朴一帥，但內心真正愛的是僕人石鐵，礙於身分地位的落差，榴蓮與石鐵始終只能維持主僕關係，石鐵更是遭婆婆痛下殺手。榴蓮和石鐵的兒子朴言，對金素貯一見鍾情，兩人馬上結為夫妻，然而朴言驟然離世，傷痛欲絕的婆媳倆人，竟在月蝕之夜穿越到了現代，並在丹家別墅中再次見到了曾經的愛人、丈夫，在這一世中他們會擦出什麼樣的火花呢？

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【王牌律師X怪物新人法律界最強拍檔真相一觸即發！】在韓國頂尖律師事務所KANG&HAM，崔江錫是無人能敵的王牌律師，精準果敢、戰無不勝。一次偶然，他遇見高延宇──沒有法學背景、未取得律師執照，卻擁有怪物般的驚人記憶力。慧眼識珠的江錫破格將他納入團隊，從此兩人成為法律界最強黃金拍檔。在法庭上縱橫捭闔、揭露真相與陰謀，他們並肩作戰，也建立深厚情誼，並在愛與抉擇間踏上命運的新篇章。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 紅天機
programme.desc: 【國民妹妹金裕貞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭時暘眾多男神演員！！】朝鮮時代進入景福宮的絕世美女畫工紅天機（金裕貞飾），和失明但可以讀懂天空和星座的觀象監河覽（安孝燮飾），風流倜儻的亮明大君（孔明飾)，夢想成為王的周向大君(郭時暘飾)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人類的魔王同時存在展開的奇幻愛情古裝劇。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 玉面桃花總相逢
programme.desc: 本劇改編自藍艾草的同名小說，許清嘉自幼父母雙亡，寒門苦讀成榜眼，與世交胡家的小女胡嬌喜結連理。胡嬌雖然出身屠戶家，不通文墨，但性格開朗積極、不拘小節，將一切打理得井井有條。

programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: 玉面桃花總相逢
programme.desc: 本劇改編自藍艾草的同名小說，許清嘉自幼父母雙亡，寒門苦讀成榜眼，與世交胡家的小女胡嬌喜結連理。胡嬌雖然出身屠戶家，不通文墨，但性格開朗積極、不拘小節，將一切打理得井井有條。

programme.title: 紅天機
programme.desc: 【國民妹妹金裕貞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭時暘眾多男神演員！！】朝鮮時代進入景福宮的絕世美女畫工紅天機（金裕貞飾），和失明但可以讀懂天空和星座的觀象監河覽（安孝燮飾），風流倜儻的亮明大君（孔明飾)，夢想成為王的周向大君(郭時暘飾)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人類的魔王同時存在展開的奇幻愛情古裝劇。

programme.title: 逆轉女王
programme.desc: 【經典韓劇《賢內助女王》姊妹作】黃泰熙原是高薪的開發組長，但為了追求幸福家庭，她選擇與新同事奉俊秀結婚。然而她的決定，卻讓她被信任的女上司趕出公司，只能在家當賢內助。五年後，泰熙感到現實生活的沉重，決定重返職場。在公司她遇見了具勇植，一位支持她的本部長。泰熙在勇植的鼓勵下展現出更堅韌的一面，最終成功東山再起，找到了新的事業目標。

programme.title: 最佳愛情
programme.desc: 【知名編劇「洪氏姊妹」執筆當紅VS過氣偶像間的戀愛羅曼史】正值演藝巔峰的獨孤振，不但是廣告界寵兒，更是國民好感度第一的男星！而具愛貞則是前當紅偶像團體「國寶少女」成員，因過氣只好跑跑通告維持生計。獨孤振在一次試鏡中，因英語程度不佳，丟失了出演機會，沒想到這丟人的祕密，居然被具愛貞給知道了！國民喜愛的男星碰上國民唾棄的女星，他們能克服眾人的偏見勇敢去愛嗎?一場荒謬又有趣的浪漫戀曲即將展開。

programme.title: 抓住你的衣領
programme.desc: 【改編榮獲韓國網路小說懸疑類大獎，熱血記者金荷娜攜手前男友延玗臻聯手調查！】擅長挖掘獨家新聞的女記者徐貞媛，除事業上的成功，與作家丈夫薛宇宰的幸福婚後生活也令人稱羨。某日在犯罪現場成為了目擊者，隨著越演越烈的風波被懷疑為殺人犯，爲證明自己的清白而向刑警前男友泰憲尋求幫助，聯手找尋真相。

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 最佳愛情

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉和丈夫恩範已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因恩範外遇出軌導致離婚收場。荷拉時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 向風而行
programme.desc: 【《請叫我總監》譚松韻與《清平樂》王凱，飛向天際攜手築夢！！】鷺洲航空客運飛行部副部長顧南亭因公司改制，與性格颯爽不羈的程霄成為上下屬和師徒關係。面對接踵而來的突發航空事件，追求穩定秩序的顧南亭時常被不按常理出牌的程霄打亂計劃，共同經歷衝擊與考驗，一路披荊斬棘、相扶成長。

programme.title: 大學成人式-被不良少年迷住3-
programme.desc: 【《魷魚遊戲》李廷晙、DAY6元弼、CIX炫晳、EPEX琴洞弦，眾多偶像齊聚一堂，共譜青春愛情劇！！】因一場誤會讓模範生妍鬥與校園惡霸賢浩有了連結，在結束了高中時期的紛擾，進入大學就讀的妍鬥與賢浩，以為平靜的日子將會是日常生活。隨著新認識的朋友，兩人想解決複雜的誤會和矛盾產生，看似複雜的愛情公式，誰才是妍鬥最終的選擇?

programme.title: 愛情是Beautiful，人生是Wonderful
programme.desc: 【《月水金火木土》金宰永攜手《社內相親》薛仁雅尋找幸福小確幸！！！】清雅是一名放棄戀愛和結婚，努力在生活中，連續八年準備警察公務員卻無法合格的社會小螺絲。俊輝則是一名對他人毫無興趣的不婚主義者，不管是愛情、友情還是親情都秉持N分之一的態度。認識了彼此開始尋找瑣碎但現實的小確幸，並開始認知愛情是美好的人生是精彩的。

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Peas and Quiet
programme.desc: There are odd noises in the supermarket. Supertato discovers that Evil Pea and the Mini Peas are asleep and walking through the supermarket. Supertato tries to get them back to bed.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Broccoli's Movie Night
programme.desc: Broccoli screens Supertato: The Movie, but Evil Pea has plans to change the story.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Keepy Uppy
programme.desc: Bluey, Bingo and Mum are enjoying playing Keepy-Uppy around the house, when Dad joins in and the game becomes the ultimate test of skill.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Bbq
programme.desc: It's lunchtime on Bluey's deck! But the BBQ needs a salad, so Bingo's relaxing sit-down will have to wait until she finds every colour of capsicum her cousins asked for!

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Hotel
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo run a crazy "Hotel" with Dad as their put upon guest. But when Bingo quits over Bluey being too controlling, Dad needs to teach them how to compromise.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Blue Mountains
programme.desc: Bluey, Bingo, Mum and Dad play a game of hand puppets, exploring the land beyond the Blue Mountains where they outsmart the Cheeky Fox to find the softest ever beds.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Camping
programme.desc: While on a camping holiday, Bluey makes a new friend named called Jean-Luc. Bluey may not understand him, but they find a common language playing and hunting for a wild Daddy pig.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Dance Mode
programme.desc: After Dad eats her last chip, Bingo is given three chances to put Mum and Dad in "Dance Mode" as payback. But the others can't resist taking Bingo's turns for her.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Daddy Dropoff
programme.desc: Dad refuses to be late dropping off Bluey and Bingo at kindy and school, but the girls make Dad play so many games, they quickly derail his plan.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - The Show
programme.desc: When Bingo drops Mum's breakfast-in-bed on the floor, she's convinced she's ruined her big day. But Bluey helps make amends by putting on a play of how Mum and Dad first met.

programme.title: Kazoops! (S1) - Monty Repeats Himself
programme.desc: A teacher asks Monty to paint something new instead of repeating himself, but Monty thinks repetition can sometimes be useful.

programme.title: JoJo &amp; Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time to Make a Family Tree
programme.desc: Great-Gran Gran shows JoJo an old family photo - it's fun spotting Gran Gran, Mummy and Great-Gran Gran when they were younger. JoJo recognises some people, but there are lots of members of her family that she's never met before.

programme.title: JoJo &amp; Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time for a Harvest Festival
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran join Julie at the farm for the harvest festival. Julie gives JoJo, Gran Gran and their friends a special tractor ride to the harvesting field, where there's lots for everyone to do.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Moon's Exhibition
programme.desc: A trip to the art gallery unexpectedly helps Duck with the hunt for his lost toy Rhino.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Tummy Talk
programme.desc: When Sarah forgets her sandwich, her rumbling tummy inadvertently starts a conversation with a Frog.

programme.title: Thomas &amp; Friends (S23) - Rangers of the Rails
programme.desc: A bit bored by her surroundings, Emily longs to go on a fun adventure and experience something new and exciting. It's not long before her wish is granted.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Bad Mood
programme.desc: Bingo is playing Bad Mood with Dad, standing on his feet as Dad stomps around the house, controlling everything Bingo does and causing chaos.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Octopus
programme.desc: When Chloe tries to teach her dad to improvise and play Bluey's game of Octopus at home, he finds it hard to understand or enjoy, until they both realize they can play it their own way.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Bin Night
programme.desc: Bluey, Bingo and Dad always take out the bins. Over a few weeks, Bingo tells Dad about a new kid at kindy who is mean to her and Mum offers some good advice.

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Speedy Pea
programme.desc: Evil Pea steals Supertato's brand new Tato Car but doesn't realise that the Grape Kids are in the back seat. Supertato has to get the Grape Kids back to safety and save his car.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Glasses Badge
programme.desc: When Mole was young he wanted to be a Stunt Mole! Can Duggee and the squirrels help make his dreams come true?

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Tooth Brushing Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels meet a lion with unfortunate breath.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - I'm Hungry
programme.desc: King Tiger and the Jelly wonder what Duggee has planned for today. Tag wants a snack, Enid has a musical cheese chase, and Norrie has a haircut.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Stokkur Geyser, Iceland
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are off to see the Geysers in Iceland, but Grandmaster Glitch and the Grimbots have beaten them to it, and managed to get themselves stuck in the Geysers.

programme.desc: Cartoon following four adventure-seeking superheroes as they explore exciting places all around the world.

programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch wants to watch his favourite DVD in peace, so uses his remote control to pause the Rio Carnival in Brazil!

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Dance Mode
programme.desc: After Dad eats her last chip, Bingo is given three chances to put Mum and Dad in "Dance Mode" as payback. But the others can't resist taking Bingo's turns for her.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Daddy Dropoff
programme.desc: Dad refuses to be late dropping off Bluey and Bingo at kindy and school, but the girls make Dad play so many games, they quickly derail his plan.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - The Show
programme.desc: When Bingo drops Mum's breakfast-in-bed on the floor, she's convinced she's ruined her big day. But Bluey helps make amends by putting on a play of how Mum and Dad first met.

programme.title: Kazoops! (S1) - Monty Repeats Himself
programme.desc: A teacher asks Monty to paint something new instead of repeating himself, but Monty thinks repetition can sometimes be useful.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time to Make a Family Tree
programme.desc: Great-Gran Gran shows JoJo an old family photo - it's fun spotting Gran Gran, Mummy and Great-Gran Gran when they were younger. JoJo recognises some people, but there are lots of members of her family that she's never met before.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time for a Harvest Festival
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran join Julie at the farm for the harvest festival. Julie gives JoJo, Gran Gran and their friends a special tractor ride to the harvesting field, where there's lots for everyone to do.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Moon's Exhibition
programme.desc: A trip to the art gallery unexpectedly helps Duck with the hunt for his lost toy Rhino.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Tummy Talk
programme.desc: When Sarah forgets her sandwich, her rumbling tummy inadvertently starts a conversation with a Frog.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S23) - Rangers of the Rails
programme.desc: A bit bored by her surroundings, Emily longs to go on a fun adventure and experience something new and exciting. It's not long before her wish is granted.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Bad Mood
programme.desc: Bingo is playing Bad Mood with Dad, standing on his feet as Dad stomps around the house, controlling everything Bingo does and causing chaos.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Octopus
programme.desc: When Chloe tries to teach her dad to improvise and play Bluey's game of Octopus at home, he finds it hard to understand or enjoy, until they both realize they can play it their own way.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Bin Night
programme.desc: Bluey, Bingo and Dad always take out the bins. Over a few weeks, Bingo tells Dad about a new kid at kindy who is mean to her and Mum offers some good advice.

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Speedy Pea
programme.desc: Evil Pea steals Supertato's brand new Tato Car but doesn't realise that the Grape Kids are in the back seat. Supertato has to get the Grape Kids back to safety and save his car.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Glasses Badge
programme.desc: When Mole was young he wanted to be a Stunt Mole! Can Duggee and the squirrels help make his dreams come true?

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Tooth Brushing Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels meet a lion with unfortunate breath.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - I'm Hungry
programme.desc: King Tiger and the Jelly wonder what Duggee has planned for today. Tag wants a snack, Enid has a musical cheese chase, and Norrie has a haircut.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Stokkur Geyser, Iceland
programme.desc: The Go Jetters are off to see the Geysers in Iceland, but Grandmaster Glitch and the Grimbots have beaten them to it, and managed to get themselves stuck in the Geysers.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Aqueduct of Segovia
programme.desc: Cartoon following four adventure-seeking superheroes as they explore exciting places all around the world.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch wants to watch his favourite DVD in peace, so uses his remote control to pause the Rio Carnival in Brazil!

programme.title: My World Kitchen (S4) - Vinnie's Bristolian Asparagus Tart
programme.desc: Vinnie's tarts are made of puff pastry with a cream cheese and asparagus topping. Yum!

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Meerkat Pups
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head off on a global adventure to Botswana, Africa and embark on a baby animal mission to help a meerkat family move home. Along the way, Andy meets some zebra and must race across an enormous salt pan to escape a hungry jackal.

programme.title: Swashbuckle (S7) - Captain Captain's Classic Clips
programme.desc: Squawk takes us on a journey to find Captain Captain's top Swashbuckle moments, her classic clips, which are all hidden along a pirate treasure map.

programme.title: Panda and Krash (S1) - Krash's New Friend
programme.desc: A beam of light sweeps through the window. Krash finds a glowing ball bouncing in the shop

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Taxi

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - The Beach
programme.desc: As Mum goes for a walk along the beach, Bluey runs to catch up with her. Along the way, she has a series of encounters that both excite and test her in her first solo adventure.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Pirates

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Circus

programme.desc: When Muffin can't stop sucking her thumb, she has to wear a cone of shame. But the cone gets in her way and she can no longer play `sandwich shop' with Bluey and Bingo.

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Ahoy Captain Pak Choi
programme.desc: Supertato and Broccoli go on a pirate adventure with Captain Pak Choi, but they don't realise she intends on plundering Evil Pea's freezer and stealing all her shiny things.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Tooth Brushing Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels meet a lion with unfortunate breath.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S3) - The Duck Badge
programme.desc: The clubhouse is inundated with stray ducklings who think Norrie is their mum.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Potato Time
programme.desc: At Squirrel Club, Duggee forgets how to woof, Duggly comes to visit, Roly celebrates Potato Time, and Billy teaches everyone the Bugatron dance!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Aqueduct of Segovia
programme.desc: Cartoon following four adventure-seeking superheroes as they explore exciting places all around the world.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch wants to watch his favourite DVD in peace, so uses his remote control to pause the Rio Carnival in Brazil!

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - Mount Everest, Asia
programme.desc: Kyan wants to climb Mount Everest, but his daring plan is interrupted by Grandmaster Glitch, who's careering down the mountain in a giant snowball.

programme.title: My World Kitchen (S4) - Zahra-Rose's Somalian Nafaqo
programme.desc: Zahra-Rose's dish is Somalian nafaqo, made using mashed potato stuffed with boiled egg.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Baby Lar Gibbons
programme.desc: Andy encounters some baby Lar Gibbons in Thailand that appear to be flying as they swing through the rainforest.

programme.title: Swashbuckle (S7) - Sandy and Seaweed's Super Snippets
programme.desc: Squawk takes us on a journey to find Sandy and Seaweed's top Swashbuckle moments, their super snippets, which are all hidden along a pirate treasure map.

programme.title: Panda and Krash (S1) - Castle Calamity
programme.desc: Rori is building a castle with building blocks, which intrigues everyone.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - The Beach
programme.desc: As Mum goes for a walk along the beach, Bluey runs to catch up with her. Along the way, she has a series of encounters that both excite and test her in her first solo adventure.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Camping
programme.desc: While on a camping holiday, Bluey makes a new friend named called Jean-Luc. Bluey may not understand him, but they find a common language playing and hunting for a wild Daddy pig.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Grannies
programme.desc: A game of 'grannies' is fun, until Bluey and Bingo can't agree on one simple question: Can Grannies dance? Now they need to video call Nana to get the answer.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Wishing Tree
programme.desc: Evil Pea blows all the lanterns away during the Lantern Festival. Supertato struggles to get them all back and needs Broccoli's help to save the day.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Movies
programme.desc: It's Bluey's first trip to the cinema, but she's worried the movie will be too scary. When Bingo starts running amok in the theatre, she must conquer her fear and help Dad out.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: My Young Auntie
programme.desc: An elderly landowner marries young Dai Nan to keep his inheritance away from his unscrupulous nephew before he dies. When Dai Nan brings along the deed to meet his other nephew, a series of amusing incidents happen with this "young" auntie, the nephew and his son. Kara Hui won Best Actress in the first Hong Kong Film Awards for her role as Dai Nan.

programme.title: Songfest
programme.desc: As its name implies, Songfest is an Eastmancolor-Shawscope costume musical, traditionally Chinese and timeless in content; yet revealing a spirited and modern technique. Shot on location at Taiwan's beautiful Sun-Moon Lake, it's a turbulent romance between a passionate tea picker Sung Yu Lan and a charming fisherman Li Chun Yang.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2
programme.desc: In a time of anti-Manchu sentiment, Emperor Yong Zheng employs his ruthless Blood Hound Corps to silence any dissenters. Only one man and his signature weapon, The Flying Guillotine, stand in their way.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor's sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: The Golden Sword
programme.desc: Swordsman Long meets Feng while searching for his missing father and they soon fall in love and marry. When Long is kidnapped by 'Dragon Gate Palace' one day, Feng embarks on a rescue mission and reunites with Long, who manages to escape. Together, they confront the head of 'Dragon Gate Palace', and uncover a long-hidden secret.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: This joyous, raucous, & colorful tunefest showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of 3 girls dancing their way to the top.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 3
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong go to Iron Palm Peak to search for the Book of Wumu. The chief of Iron Palm discovers their visit, and seriously injures Huang. It seems only the Southern Emperor Duan can heal her, but will Huang be healed in time?

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: Shot on the Shaws' lot in the final years of Hong Kong's greatest studio, The Enchantress tells the story of martial artists who disappear in the night! Intrigued, wanna-be detectiveswordsman Feng Chi-wu (Mok Siu-chung) is determined to find out what is happening. But when Feng finds out that an evil vampire spirit (Wei Chiu-hua) is killing swordsmen, he's in for more than he bargains for... It's an outlandish fairy-tale and martial arts fantasy, where your fists and sword aren't nearly enough!

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: Shot on the Shaws' lot in the final years of Hong Kong's greatest studio, The Enchantress tells the story of martial artists who disappear in the night! Intrigued, wanna-be detectiveswordsman Feng Chi-wu (Mok Siu-chung) is determined to find out what is happening. But when Feng finds out that an evil vampire spirit (Wei Chiu-hua) is killing swordsmen, he's in for more than he bargains for... It's an outlandish fairy-tale and martial arts fantasy, where your fists and sword aren't nearly enough!

programme.title: The Amorous Lotus Pan
programme.desc: Adapted from the renowned Chinese novel, The Water Margin, this is the story of a poor and beautiful girl Lotus Pan, who is raped by her master and had to be married off to a midget who treats her badly. Lost and lonely, Pan unwittingly becomes a pawn in the game of lust between her husband's playboy brother Wu Song, and a murderous man Men Ching.

programme.title: Clan Of The White Lotus
programme.desc: The head of White Lotus Clan, Lo, is a highly skilled martial artist who supports the Qing government and helps destroy the rebellion group. Hung from Shaolin who kills Lo's brother, is being hunted and hides in another rebel Hu's house. The clan attacks at night killing Hu and his sister, but Hung manages to get Hu's pregnant wife to safety.

programme.title: The Trail of the Broken Blade
programme.desc: After avenging his father's death by assassinating a high official, Li Yue disappears into hiding as a fugitive. His fiancee enlists a swordsman-who secretly loves her-to search for him, unaware that the bandit Xiao Mei has also fallen for Li Yue. Their intertwined love quadrangle explores themes of sacrifice, devotion and selfless love.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: Secret Service of the Imperial Court
programme.desc: Zhao Bu Fan is the sergeant of the government's secret police. Wang is a cruel and ruthless eunuch who takes over the Emperor's ruling power and leads the team of secret agents. After witnessing the atrocities committed by Eunuch Wang, Sergeant Zhao decides to defect but ends up being hunted by his friends, comrades and even his father.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: Angel with the Iron Fists
programme.desc: Lo Wei directs and stars as the chief detective in this gripping thriller; playing alongside Lily Ho, who excels in the role of an undercover avenger that can fight as well as she flirts! Caught between the crime bosses known as Baldhead and Black Widow, she only has four choices: punch, kick, shoot or bombard with explosives!

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her...

programme.title: That Fiery Girl
programme.desc: The bandits of Hulu Valley slay the chief of the Mei Clan while searching for a treasure map. In retaliation, Chun from the Mei Clan infiltrates the bandit's fortress to map a way in for the authorities, but ends up falling in love with the bandit leader's daughter, Pearl. While Chun's plot is uncovered, he receives unexpected help from Pearl.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Young carriage driver Kin offends the gangsters by saving a young girl. His boss immediately fires him to avoid getting into trouble. Since then, Kin is determined to protect the weak and learns the "Tsai Li Fu" style of martial arts from a Shaolin master to challenge the gangsters, finally beating them.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: A group of farmers who are being oppressed by the local magistrates kidnap one of the magistrate's daughter in the hope of being heard by the authorities. A wandering swordsman offers his help and aiding him are two fighters who have both switched sides from being the oppressors to the oppressed. The trio fight back against the magistrates!

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: The Gambling Syndicate
programme.desc: A young provincial detective seeks to take down a local gambling syndicate with the help of two convicts.

programme.title: Intimate Confessions of a Chinese Courtesan
programme.desc: Young Ai Nu is abducted and sold to the popular Four Seasons brothel run by the powerful and ruthless Madam Chun Yi. Ai Nu gets locked up in a dungeon due to her fiery attitude. Soon, a murder occurs within the brothel and a policeman must race against time to prevent a vicious revenge plot from reaching its blood-spattered conclusion.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: Killers On Wheels
programme.desc: Kuo takes his family to an outlying island of Hong Kong for a vacation. On the ferry, they meet a group of young hooligans cum motorcyclists called the "speed gang", led by Johnny, and Kuo's sister Carrie is molested by Johnny's brother Michael. Kuo's family continues to be harassed by the "speed gang" while on the island - can Kuo protect them?

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines. Feng is finally killed by his officers, but will the new general rule the city differently?

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hon's pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sister's death, but is shocked to discover that her fiance, Jin, is one of them. At the same time, Jin's mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng. Can Feng fight back and take her revenge?

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: Only by bringing together the powerful Heaven Sword and the mighty Dragon Sabre can six martial arts sects struggling for supremacy be saved in this thrilling sequel to Chu Yuan's original hit.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: After years in prison, Lu Hu returns home to find himself set up by his ruthless brother Piao, who has taken over the family coal mine business and imprisoned their sister. Hu takes down Piao and saves his sister but their coal mine falls into the hands of a Japanese gang, which Hu and his sister must fight in order to get it back.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiance Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan...

programme.title: The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Li Xun Huan is a sentimental swordsman who has lived peacefully outside the martial arts world for the past ten years. He returns home after knowing that the Plum Blossom Bandit is back to his old tricks, only to find that everything has changed.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong cop Eddie is hired by the Interpol to capture a human smuggling gang leader known as Snakehead. Eddie dies in an action to protect a sacred child from being kidnapped, but is brought back to life by the child's magical medallion, allowing him to finally kill Snakehead.

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 3
programme.desc: Gambling tycoon Man suddenly marries his new partner Sophie, which shocked his only son, Ken. In the wake of Man's heart attack, Ken must battle Sophie - who has persuaded Man to transfer his grand master title to her in the event of his death - for the rightful claim to the family's gambling business in a riveting game of mahjong.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
programme.desc: Teddy, once a renowned movie star, is facing a career decline. To make a living, he accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. Teddy's career regains momentum after he reunites with his long-lost daughter, but he is also confronted by a rival at the same time. His daughter and disciples decide to help him overcome this difficult situation...

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: The Exodus
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair
programme.desc: As Wudang disciple Zhuo Yi Hang confronts the Demon Palace, he reunites with Lian Ni Shang, the woman who once saved him, and their love reignites. Lian, a disciple of the Demon Palace, endures torment to be with Zhuo but is shattered when he accidentally injures her. A fierce battle between good and evil unfolds!

programme.title: Protege
programme.desc: Undercover Police Nick has spent 8 years working for the drug baron Quin, so as to collect evidence of his drug trafficking activities. After gaining Quin's trust, Nick becomes his protege and succeeds him as the drug baron when Quin retires. However, Nick has lost himself in his split life between trading drugs and searching for criminal evidence.

programme.title: Midnight Fly
programme.desc: With her marriage in crisis, Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husband's mistress. When Miki goes missing in Morocco, Michele does everything she can to find her but ends up paying a heavy price...

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Hong Kong tycoon Ren Da Kuan takes care of his family that spans four generations, yet his three sons grapple with their own challenges. Everything changes when his daughter returns from studying in France with her friend Roberto. Roberto brings a wave of transformation to the Ren family, sparking new hope and opportunities for all.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well Too
programme.desc: Another super comedy directed by Clifton Ko about more farcical couplings, mistaken identities, infidelities, and arranged marriages set in the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Golden Chicken 2
programme.desc: The sequel is set in 2046 when a 82-year-old Ah Kam stops a heartbroken young man from taking memory loss pills. To help ease his pain, Ah Kam shares her life stories from 2003, one of Hong Kong's toughest year with SARS, including the different people she comes across and the bittersweet romance between herself and her cousin.

programme.title: Golden Chicken 2
programme.desc: The sequel is set in 2046 when a 82-year-old Ah Kam stops a heartbroken young man from taking memory loss pills. To help ease his pain, Ah Kam shares her life stories from 2003, one of Hong Kong's toughest year with SARS, including the different people she comes across and the bittersweet romance between herself and her cousin.

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 2
programme.desc: Fanny appears to be an ordinary housewife but is in fact a mahjong expert. Deeply in love with her husband, she loses to a seductive woman, Curvy, both on the mahjong table and in competing for her husband's love. With the help from her mahjong master, Fanny vows to take on Curvy in the Mahjong King tournament!

programme.title: Everlasting Regret
programme.desc: Adapted from an award-winning Chinese novel, the story follows the life of a legendary Shanghai beauty Wang Qi Yao from her glamorous to her simpler days. She stays true to her own way of life while surviving the constant betrayal of her men, and bears witness to the waves of change to her city from 1947 to 1981.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip's boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim's sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist's drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: The Eye 10
programme.desc: This third installment of 'The Eye' horror movie series is about the creepy adventures of a group of teenagers who summon spirits by using the ten methods outlined in a mysterious comic book while vacationing in Thailand.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The famous "Gang Trio" is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million dollars. When they realize that the triad is after both the ransom and the baby's life, they decide to make the hostage their protege. Cornered by cops and threatened by gangsters, the three 'Rob-B-Hood' must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: The Eye
programme.desc: Mun undergoes a cornea transplant to correct her blindness, but ends up gaining more than the gift of sight. She shockingly realises that she is seeing another woman instead of herself whenever she looks into a mirror. Recalling that things changed ever since her cornea was replaced, Mun vows to uncover the truth behind her strange vision...

programme.title: Everlasting Love
programme.desc: Young intern doctor Eric meets Pei Jun and quickly falls in love with her, unaware that she works as a hostess in a night club. Despite their social differences, can their love story defy the odds and lead to a happily ever after?

programme.title: Undercover Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: In this hilarious comedy, Fat is a gangster who suffers from amnesia. Believing that he is actually an undercover policeman, Fat attempts to arrest gang leader Big Bro, but instead becomes the gangsters' best ally. To complicate matters further, a gangster named Wind, who looks exactly like Fat, starts a turf war with Big Bro.

programme.title: New Police Story
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Wing is an elite in the police force but has been drowning his guilt in booze after his entire team was killed by the "Gang of Five" in a mission. A year later, a young rookie detective with a complicated background is assigned to partner Wing and manages to inspire him into action, as Wing vows to take down the gang.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam's life. Ma's fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: City of Desire
programme.desc: Sister 13 returns to Macau after 17 years to succeed her father's underground empire, the prostitution business. She tries to stop their exploitation of the sex workers, but Macau's economy flourished after the handover, propelling the prostitution and gambling businesses. The city is blinded by desire and Sister 13 can do nothing to help...

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: God of Gambler's Return
programme.desc: The God of Gamblers, Gao Jin, quits gambling and live a quiet life with his wife. However, a Taiwanese crime boss wants to become the new God of Gamblers and get rid of him, so he kills Gao Jin's pregnant wife to force him to the casino table. Gao Jin is indignant and vows to fight the crime boss to avenge his wife's death.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Man Wanted 3
programme.desc: Street kid Dong idolizes Mongkok triad leader Pu Jun and inadvertently joins his gang. When rival Xi Yang seizes control by illicit means, Pu Jun decides to take him down. At the same time, Pu Jun uncovers Dong as a police undercover and banishes him, but Dong sheds his undercover identity to join Pu Jun to seek revenge against Xi Yang.

programme.title: Bullet and Brain
programme.desc: Nine years ago, two legendary criminals, Bullet and Brain, vowed not to kill and lie before they disappeared. Both now return for a mission - to protect the granddaughter of the triad boss. Can they succeed without breaking their vows?

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair II
programme.desc: After being betrayed by Zhuo, the white-haired witch Lian seeks revenge by slaughtering her way through the eight martial arts clans. However, she is soon attacked by a man whose bride she has abducted. Meanwhile, Zhuo, who is waiting on a hilltop for a flower to bloom for Lian's restoration, hastens to save her upon realizing the danger she is in.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants And The Hazardous Hysteria Of The Hangry Hypnosinger
programme.desc: Everybody on the spaceship has been cryogenically frozen for three months - everyone, that is, except Krupp, who's wide awake and happily in charge.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - The Longest Day
programme.desc: During the week of the Midnight Sun where the sun doesn't set for a week, Hiccup must deal with sleep deprivation and a dangerous new dragon.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Gold Rush
programme.desc: Hiccup and the Riders, with help from Dagur hatch a plan to steal Berk's gold back.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S2 - Hole In The Sky

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - 127 Owwws 28 Fleas Later
programme.desc: Eep and Thunk become obsessed with a new trend known as "quicktogramming"Grug accidentally causes the first outbreak of a "super bug"

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the Two-Wheeled Terror

programme.title: Dinotrux S2 - Slamtools
programme.desc: Garby and Click-Clack must rescue the Dinotruxafter they are tied down by a destructive tribe of Slamtools who made an evil deal with D-Structs

programme.desc: Crocky has got his foot stuck in a bucket, which makes lots of noise every time he walks. It's great fun making lots of noise at first, but soon Crocky tires of the bucket stuck on his foot. How can Raa Raa and the other jungle animals help Crocky remove the bucket?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa's New Noise
programme.desc: Raa Raa wants to find the perfect noise to partner his friend Huffty in a tune. He hears an amazing new noise but does not know what made it… he sets out on a noisy discovery to find out how to recreate this wonderful new noise.

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Crocky's Wobbly Tooth
programme.desc: Crocky has got a wobbly tooth. He really wants it to fall out. He and his friends try all sorts of different ways to try and help the tooth fall out… will any of them work?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Littlest Laugh
programme.desc: Raa Raa and Ooo Ooo are trying to find out who is the funniest animal in the Jingly Jangly Jungle. But they soon realise that they are much funnier when they are together.

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Hide And Toot
programme.desc: The animals are playing hide and seek. Huffty gets upset when his trunk keeps giving him away. Can Raa Raa and his friends show the little elephant that his trunk is really rather wonderful?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Boing Boing
programme.desc: Raa Raa has got a new pogo stick. He is having a great time bouncing around, but his friends aren't so sure… he seems to be causing rather a lot of damage. Is there any way Raa Raa can practise without destroying their jungle home?

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - DJ Catnip Gets His Groove Back
programme.desc: Gabby brings DJ Catnip a microphone for him to use in the big music show, but he has some terrible news: he lost his groove! Determined to help him get his groove back, Gabby and Pandy take him on a musical search through the dollhouse. As they go, Gabby uses the microphone to record sounds from the Gabby Cats’ everyday activities that culminate into a new song that gets DJ his groove back just in time for the show! In our Gabby Cat of the Day Segment, Gabby sings a song!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - Kitty Fairy Gets Sick
programme.desc: When Gabby unboxes a recipe for dandelion soup and a soup bowl, she discovers Kitty Fairy is sick! Gabby and Pandy make her some delicious dandelion soup and while she rests, they take care of her Garden. With the help of all the Gabby Cats, they water the Singing Flowers, help the Rainbow Kitty Bushes regain their color, and sing some fussy Itty Bitty Blossoms a lullaby. For our Gabby Cat of the Day segment, Kitty Fairy sings a song!

programme.title: Gods Of Honour - EP24
programme.desc: NAR JAR (CHAN HO MAN, BENNY) was a ‘Fire master’ in his previous life. He was killed by LEE CHING (YUEN WAH). After reincarnation, he ironically becomes CHING’s third son. He is very much affected by his old memories and cannot forgive his father. CHING also keeps his distance from him because of his exotic nature and eventually sends him away with excuses. Luckily, he is saved by some kind people and becomes a General when he is still a teenager.

programme.title: Madam Cutie On Duty - EP13
programme.desc: FA PING (Priscilla Wong), who was often made fun of by the others for being ugly during her childhood, underwent cosmetic surgery in the wake of an accident. Ever since then, she has been firmly convinced that an attractive appearance has a significant impact on one's life, and remains the same after joining the police.

programme.title: I've Got The Power - EP9
programme.desc: Chung Hau-nin (Ruco Chan), Kiu Yeuk-lam (Natalie Tong) and Ko Yung (Joel Chan) are complete strangers. After surviving a traffic accident, they astonishingly gain mystical power!_x000D__x000D_Hau-nin and Ding Shuk-man (Moon Lau) are a loving young married couple. Hau-nin intends to use his mystical power for his own benefit, but he knows how to use his mystical power to help other people as he is influenced by Yeuk-lam, who has a righteous character.

programme.title: Battle Against Evil, The - EP10
programme.desc: General LI (TONG, MICHAEL) of the Chor Kingdom and wizard CHAI (CHAN HO, MOSES) were colleagues under the same mentor. LI killed CHAR when he found out that CHAR was having an affair with his wife SUKI (LEUNG TSAND, JADE). SUKI was ashamed of her affair, so she committed suicide. After she died, CHAI was furious and killed LI. He used bad magic to turn LI’s spirit into a cloud of hatred in order to prevent him from reincarnation.

programme.title: At The Threshold Of An Era - EP26
programme.desc: The property giant YIP WING TIM (Lo Ka Leung, Gallen) was born in the 60’s in Hong Kong. His father, honest and righteous, was betrayed by his brother and put into prison. TIM, therefore, learned to be wise. He tried all means to take revenge and fortune seeking was always on top of his priorities. With the help from his best friend MA CHI KEUNG (Kwok Chun On), TIM took over an incomplete village housing development.

LI killed CHAR when he found out that CHAR was having an affair with his wife SUKI (LEUNG TSAND, JADE). SUKI was ashamed of her affair, so she committed suicide. After she died, CHAI was furious and killed LI. He used bad magic to turn LI’s spirit into a cloud of hatred in order to prevent him from reincarnation.

programme.title: At The Threshold Of An Era - EP28
programme.desc: The property giant YIP WING TIM (Lo Ka Leung, Gallen) was born in the 60’s in Hong Kong. His father, honest and righteous, was betrayed by his brother and put into prison. TIM, therefore, learned to be wise. He tried all means to take revenge and fortune seeking was always on top of his priorities. With the help from his best friend MA CHI KEUNG (Kwok Chun On), TIM took over an incomplete village housing development.

programme.title: Gods Of Honour - EP25
programme.desc: NAR JAR (CHAN HO MAN, BENNY) was a ‘Fire master’ in his previous life. He was killed by LEE CHING (YUEN WAH). After reincarnation, he ironically becomes CHING’s third son. He is very much affected by his old memories and cannot forgive his father. CHING also keeps his distance from him because of his exotic nature and eventually sends him away with excuses. Luckily, he is saved by some kind people and becomes a General when he is still a teenager.

programme.title: Knot To Treasure - EP9
programme.desc: Wei (Zhu Jiang), the eldest son of Wei (Chen Jiewen), is wild and untamed. Under family pressure, he finally marries Shan (Zhang Fengni), with whom he has been dating for many years. Later, realizing Yan's overly open attitude towards relationships, he decides to pursue Shan again.

programme.title: Shadow Of Justice - EP27
programme.desc: Because of some transfer arrangement and several complicated cases, AICIP Au Yeung Chung (Bobby Au Yeung) and CUSP Tsui Hay-yi (Joey Meng) become collaborating partners. The duo have mutual understanding. Sheung Siu (Jeannie Chan), daughter of a logistics company boss, hates Au Yeung Chung as she is certain that he has caused her family to break up. Au Yeung Chung had promised the late Mrs. Sheung he would be tolerant of Sheung Siu.
